title: Frequency
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting, quiet suburban house at night, soft green electronic glow and cold moonlight, muted grey-blue palette with warm lamp accents, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 2. He traced the humming to an empty lot. Then it moved. 📡

Original fiction. Part 3 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: the Moss family's baby monitor picked up a woman humming and a rocking chair. They don't own a rocking chair.
scenes.image: a baby monitor glowing green on a nightstand, an old rocking chair's shadow on the wall behind it

scenes.narration: Eli is an electrician. He doesn't believe in ghosts. He believes in interference. So the next night he set up a radio scanner on the kitchen table.
scenes.image: a man at a kitchen table at night with an old radio scanner, coiled wires and a small antenna, lamp light

scenes.narration: Cheap monitors bleed. They pick up neighbors. Cordless phones. Truckers on the highway. Find the source, you find the explanation.
scenes.image: close-up of a man's hands adjusting the dial of an old radio scanner, warm lamp glow

scenes.narration: At 2:10, the humming came back. Eli turned the antenna slowly until the signal peaked. East. Toward the end of the street.
scenes.image: a hand turning a small directional antenna toward a dark kitchen window, moonlit street beyond

scenes.narration: He walked it, out the door and down the sidewalk. Two hundred meters. Three hundred. Stronger with every step.
scenes.image: a man walking alone down a dark suburban street at night holding a handheld receiver, streetlights fading

scenes.narration: Four hundred meters from his front door, it peaked. An empty lot. Weeds. A rusted mailbox. Three concrete steps leading up to nothing.
scenes.image: an empty overgrown lot at night with concrete front steps leading up to nothing, a rusted mailbox, moonlight

scenes.narration: Back home, he looked it up. A house stood there until 1979. It burned in the middle of the night. A woman lived there alone.
scenes.image: a man's face lit by a laptop glow in a dark kitchen, the window behind him black

scenes.narration: One line in the old report stuck with him. The fire started in the back bedroom. Next to a rocking chair.
scenes.image: faded old photograph of a small wooden house with smoke rising behind it, night, 1970s tones

scenes.narration: At 3 AM, the scanner was still humming. And for the first time, it wasn't pointing east.
scenes.image: the radio scanner on the kitchen table, its small needle swinging, the room dark around it

scenes.narration: Eli followed the needle. It climbed, and climbed, and pointed straight at the ceiling. At their bedroom.
scenes.image: a man at the bottom of a dark staircase looking up, holding an antenna toward the ceiling, green light above
